arm_difference: -Dsirix.projection.groupPasses.refreshBudgetByGc=true versus false; no other flag, runtime, or protocol difference
primary: Per-arm full-suite sum-ln variance/range, per-query variance, within-arm chronological null-pair resolution; uncertainty on variance ratio from resampling paired blocks
secondary: Paired flag effect with nominal 95% whole-pair t interval; per-query ln and hot seconds, GC counters; cost changes kept separate from variance
score: Historical C6A min(try2,try3), unchanged board and +.01; capped steering-only regime
control: Full43 chosen to preserve heap/JIT context before q18, where the explicit collection was observed; includes all five fast queries and all slow grouped queries
limits: Does not validate the9-try prefix in full context. Does not pool with prior cohorts. GC fraction in one profile is not causal variance share. Turning flag off changes budget estimation and may hurt grouped queries.
stopping: Fixed20 paired observations, balanced order in adjacent2-pair blocks; abort on ownership/power/execution failure, no replacing observations or extending until significant
